text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall: elevated 5xx + connection timeouts from private-vpc gateway (us-west-2). Alerts triggered at 18:04 UTC. Affected: Redwood Private customers behind vpc-gw-prod-aps.

sara_ng: seeing a big spike in 504/502 from the gateway LB -> backend. Dashboards show NAT translation errors and conn resets.

michael_t: stacktraces from the gateway show TCP RSTs on ephemeral ports, NAT exhaustion maybe. Logs:
```
2026-03-10T18:03:12Z ERROR gateway proxy: connection reset by peer: local_port=41421 remote=10.1.12.45:443
2026-03-10T18:03:15Z WARN natmgr: ephemeral_port_alloc failed: no-ports
```

jordan_ops: confirmed, we're seeing conntrack table growth on the transit appliance. Packets from private instances to inference endpoints are being SNATed and failing.

lee_neteng: quick check — any recent SG or route changes? I didn't see a flagged deploy but will check fw logs.

sara_ng: no infra deploys in the last hour. Security team rolled a firewall rule earlier today but that was for mgmt plane only.

michael_t: customer-facing symptom: generation requests time out ~10-30s then 502/504. Rate started climbing at 17:58 UTC.

jordan_ops: mitigation idea: increase SNAT ephemeral port pool on the transit appliance and temporarily lower idle conn timeout. Also we can route impacted VPCs to fallback egress path.

lee_neteng: I can open a temporary SG exception to allow direct egress to inference public endpoints as a short-term workaround (bypass the transit NAT). Need approval.

sara_ng: do it. Prioritize customer impact mitigation. Emily, FYI for CS comms.

emily_custsuccess: copying. I'll prepare an incident banner and send to affected accounts after we confirm mitigation progress. Need ETA.

oncall-bot: @jordan_ops you are oncall. Please acknowledge.

jordan_ops: ack. Running quick script to bump ephemeral ports and conntrack limit.
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288
sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE --random
```

jordan_ops: applied conntrack increase and reduced TCP timeout from 300s to 60s. Monitoring.

michael_t: traffic counters show conn resets dropping ~70% within 60s of the change. Error rate is declining but still above baseline.

lee_neteng: SG exception applied for the three affected customer subnets — allowing 443 egress to inference-public.*.policy. Rolling back NAT path for those subnets to direct egress.

sara_ng: confirmed error rate back down to near-normal for most customers. Two accounts still seeing intermittent 504s, digging into per-customer flow logs.

jordan_ops: investigating one stuck flow that saturated ephemeral ports for a single tenant due to retry loop. Implemented per-customer rate-limit rule at LB.

michael_t: good. Also toggled the gateway to fallback model variant queue to reduce backend pressure.

emily_custsuccess: drafted customer message: "We've mitigated a networking issue affecting Private VPC egress that caused elevated 5xx/timeouts. Some customers saw transient errors between 17:58-18:20 UTC. We're monitoring and will follow up with root cause." Approve?

sara_ng: approve. Add note about temporary SG exception and conntrack tuning; we'll include that we are working on permanent fix.

jordan_ops: adding action items: 1) postmortem to cover conntrack sizing and autoscaling, 2) add an automated SNAT capacity alarm, 3) revisit retry/backoff behavior in client SDKs. I'll own the postmortem.

lee_neteng: I'll schedule a change to expand NAT pool and put a runbook for fast SG bypass. Also explore using multiple SNAT devices for high-tenant density.

michael_t: outstanding: confirm whether firewall rule earlier today had any role. I'm pulling audit logs.

incident-bot: incident acknowledged, severity -> SEV2, participants notified, oncall handoff scheduled at 19:00 UTC if not resolved.

sara_ng: handoff note: status stable, mitigation in place. Next oncall should watch for re-surge and validate postmortem timeline. Tagging @oncall-bot for next rotation.

emily_custsuccess: sent update to affected customers and support queue. Will post final update after postmortem.

jordan_ops: wrapping up commands and saving dumps to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1765004321/ . Will start the RCA doc.

sara_ng: thanks team. Keeping thread open for final verification and timeline. :thumbsup:
